exec_reload: ExecReload={ path=/usr/local/sbin/set1-owner-reload-hook ; argv[]=/usr/local/sbin/set1-owner-reload-hook ; ignore_errors=no ; start_time=[n/a] ; stop_time=[n/a] ; pid=0 ; code=(null) ; status=0/0 }
script_text:
#!/bin/sh
# owner hook: reload the pooler first, then tell PostgreSQL to re-read its files
/usr/bin/systemctl reload set1-owner-pooler.service || exit 1
exec kill -HUP "$MAINPID"
